% The exact occurrence i is not a tuple of time and detector. It binds the
% observation; detector occurrence and UID; stable RTC output index n; exact
% PTC product/application generation; segment; array/network/group; and its
% full parent chain. Time and storage positions are associated attributes or
% locators only.  z_i=Z_i^PTC is the transformed signal; gamma_i is the exact
% PTC-selected MAP-facing coefficient, when such a family exists.  x and r
% remain reserved for the paired upstream KID readout coordinates.

% A stable original occurrence u is the ALIGN-owned acquisition occurrence,
% keyed by observation, detector occurrence/UID, native occurrence identity,
% stable ALIGN slot, and exact ALIGN mapping generation.  Its own coordinate
% is the layered AST ALIGN-grid direction/tangent/continuous-pixel role bound
% to the target MAP WCS through SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE
% v0.1/r0.1.  It is never a descendant RTC-output coordinate.  The causal
% influence graph remains a separate support fact and never duplicates
% detector-seconds.

% Ordered MAP lifecycle. This remains distinct from PTC/VAL handoff-decision
% axes and from the state of an ECS evidence artifact.
\providecommand{\SCIMapLifecycleDefinition}{%
The complete ordered MAP lifecycle, its independent attempt outcome, and its
record rules appear once in the following lifecycle table.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapLifecycleReference}{%
\hyperref[rule:map-lifecycle]{the exact MAP lifecycle rule}}

\providecommand{\SCIMapLifecycleTable}{%
\phantomsection\label{rule:map-lifecycle}%
\begingroup\small
\begin{longtable}{@{}L{0.19\linewidth}L{0.38\linewidth}L{0.32\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
MAP stage & Exact meaning & Record rule\\
\midrule\endfirsthead
\toprule MAP stage & Exact meaning & Record rule\\
\midrule\endhead
\texttt{requested} & Immutable accepted intent. & Exists only for an accepted
request; it is never reconstructed from a later stage.\\
\texttt{effective} & Supported executable interpretation of that request. &
Binds supported/disabled/unavailable interpretation without mutating intent.\\
\texttt{observation\_resolved} & Every observation-specific parent,
coefficient, profile, geometry, mapping, parameter, support rule, output role,
and persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. & Supplies the
exact value/state for pre-application validation.\\
\texttt{applied} & Exact resolved operation and parameter state was invoked or
committed for one execution attempt. & Created only at the application event;
retained with exact terminal failure when output realization fails.\\
\texttt{realized} & Actual immutable accumulators, scientific output rows,
product values, role-qualified companion statuses, product identity, and
provenance were produced. & Created only for an actual MAP product; a failure-
evidence record is not product realization.\\
Attempt outcome & Exactly \texttt{succeeded}, \texttt{failed}, or
\texttt{not\_produced}. & Recorded independently of the reached lifecycle
prefix and product realization.\\
Termination rule & Stop before application; post-application terminal failure;
or applied valid policy with no support-authorized rows. & The first has no
applied or realized record. The latter two retain the applied-attempt record
and exact cause but no realized MAP product; the no-support case is
\texttt{not\_produced}, not \texttt{failed}.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
The MAP plan, coefficient selection/application, projection, support policy,
output/coadd plan, response/covariance request, product role, and
\texttt{coverage\_cut} use this same ordering. Each parameter stage binds its
exact value and provenance; a completed realization contains all five stages,
while a nonproducing attempt contains only stages actually reached.\endgroup}

\providecommand{\SCIMapAttemptOutcomeDefinition}{%
MAP product realization and application-attempt outcome are independent.
\texttt{succeeded} means the requested immutable MAP product was realized.
\texttt{failed} means the attempt terminated at an exact failure stage and
retains cause, affected scope, and nonmutation evidence without a realized MAP
product or completion marker. \texttt{not\_produced} means no MAP product was
realized without asserting producer failure; the authorized empty-support case
uses this value. A response or covariance status of \texttt{unavailable}
inside a permitted realized base bundle is a companion-status fact, not attempt
failure. Evidence-artifact realization is another independent axis.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapAttemptOutcomeReference}{%
\hyperref[rule:map-lifecycle]{the separate MAP attempt-outcome rule}}

\providecommand{\SCIMapEmptySupportDispositionBody}{%
\phantomsection\label{rule:empty-support-disposition}%
The 2026-09-08 owner directive selects for this r0.4 candidate the following
empty-support disposition; final acceptance of these exact r0.4 bytes remains
pending. If a valid applied support policy yields
\(\mathcal S_{\rm out}=\varnothing\), or a valid applied coadd support policy
yields \(\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}=\varnothing\), the application state is
\texttt{applied\_no\_support\_authorized\_output\_rows}, the product and
attempt outcome is \texttt{not\_produced}, and the exact cause is
\texttt{no\_support\_authorized\_output\_rows}. The record retains request,
effective, observation-resolved, and applied stages; exact parent and plan;
coefficient, projection, support, role and profile identities; \(Q_\star\),
thresholds and support predicates; proof that the output-row set is empty;
attempt identity, cause, and provenance. It has no realized MAP product or
completion marker and publishes no dense zero map, zero-sky measurement, valid
ordinary signal plane, no-row coadd member, or fabricated response/covariance
plane. No immutable empty-row scientific-bundle alternative is authorized.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapEmptySupportReference}{%
\hyperref[rule:empty-support-disposition]{the exact empty-support disposition}}

\providecommand{\SCIMapCandidateProfileStatusDefinition}{%
\phantomsection\label{rule:candidate-profile-status}%
For the r0.4 generation, the proposed owner-governed MAP profile semantics are
\texttt{candidate}; scientific-owner approval is \texttt{pending}; canonical
Registry registration is \texttt{pending}; source binding is \texttt{pending};
SCI-VAL activation/evaluability is \texttt{unavailable}; and an object-specific
decision realization is \texttt{unavailable}. In particular,
\SCIMapCoaddProfile{} is the proposed owner-governed aggregate-profile identity
for this candidate. After exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source
binding, and activation, SCI-VAL may evaluate it for a requested object. The
same candidate-generation separation applies to \SCIMapUpstreamProfile{}.
Earlier exact profile approvals and evaluations retain their own immutable
source generations; this candidate does not rebind or relabel them.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapCandidateProfileStatusReference}{%
\hyperref[rule:candidate-profile-status]{the exact candidate profile-status rule}}

\providecommand{\SCIMapAxisSeparationDefinition}{%
The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently named PTC/VAL handoff
axes \texttt{requested}/\texttt{not\_requested},
\texttt{applicable}/\texttt{inapplicable}/\texttt{applicability\_unknown},
\texttt{eligible}/\texttt{ineligible}/\texttt{decision\_unavailable}, and
\texttt{realized}/\texttt{incomplete}/\texttt{failed}/\texttt{not\_produced}.
It also does not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or evidence-
artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter's resolved or
applied value may be checked before application or bound after application;
its \texttt{realized} value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application
check.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapAxisSeparationReference}{%
\hyperref[rule:map-lifecycle]{the exact lifecycle and independent-axis separation rule}}

\providecommand{\SCIMapRequirementResultDefinition}{%
Every ECS requirement result is exactly one of \texttt{pass}, \texttt{fail},
\texttt{blocked}, \texttt{not\_applicable}, or \texttt{not\_assessed}.
\texttt{pass} means complete positive evidence establishes the requirement
for the exact candidate. \texttt{fail} means evaluated evidence contradicts
it. \texttt{blocked} means evaluation cannot proceed because one exact named
authority, dependency, profile, source binding, or prerequisite is
unavailable. \texttt{not\_applicable} means the requirement is outside the
exact candidate's declared role under an owner-approved rationale.
\texttt{not\_assessed} means applicable evidence has not yet been executed or
reviewed. Evidence-artifact realization is a different axis with values
\texttt{complete}, \texttt{incomplete}, \texttt{failed}, and
\texttt{not\_produced}.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapProductRoleDefinition}{%
The six independently requestable product roles are
\SCIMapBaseObservationRole, \SCIMapResponseObservationRole,
\SCIMapCovarianceObservationRole, \SCIMapBaseCoaddRole,
\SCIMapResponseCoaddRole, and \SCIMapCovarianceCoaddRole. Every request has
its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered MAP lifecycle, result, and
failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent;
it does not rewrite that parent's signal membership, response/covariance
status, validity, or provenance.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapProductRoleDependencyTable}{%
\begingroup\small
\begin{longtable}{@{}L{0.18\linewidth}L{0.24\linewidth}L{0.24\linewidth}L{0.25\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Role & Exact parent & Required companions & Missing/incompatible companion\\
\midrule\endfirsthead
\toprule Role & Exact parent & Required companions & Missing/incompatible companion\\
\midrule\endhead
Base observation & Exact realized PTC/AST inputs and complete
MAP-local observation plan & Complete MAP-local realized operator identity;
honest upstream-response and covariance states & Base signal may remain valid;
state and cause are retained.\\
Response-bearing observation & Exact base-observation product named above & Every named numerical response, with
exact source domain, basis, class, unit, normalization, parent, WCS/grid, and
row identity & This role fails or is unavailable before its required-product
mutation; its base parent is unchanged.\\
Covariance-qualified observation & Exact base-observation product named above & Every within-observation covariance
block named by the role on exact rows & Missing blocks are unknown and block
this role only; its base parent is unchanged.\\
Base coadd & Ordered set of exact complete base-observation bundles
and one resolved coadd plan & Every base signal companion and honest response
and covariance identities/statuses & Unavailable or basis-incompatible
response and incomplete covariance are permitted with unchanged signal
membership; coadd response becomes unavailable with exact cause.\\
Response-bearing coadd & Exact base-coadd parent named above and the identical
ordered signal-member set & One exact response-family identity \(R\); every
member response \(R_o^{(R)}\); compatible source domain, perturbation
definition, basis, class, unit, normalization, reference/gauge/null state,
parent, WCS/grid, and row identity; fixed membership, placement,
\(B_{\rm out}\), support and coefficients; and exact linear-composition
authority & If the base parent already exists, this stronger role is unavailable
for that parent; it never selects a subset. A separately requested admission
may reject an observation before mutation only while constructing its own
separately identified base/signal parent. No hidden subset or zero fill.\\
Covariance-qualified coadd & Exact base-coadd parent named above and the identical
ordered signal-member set & Every named within- and cross-observation block on
exact stacked rows & One missing required block blocks this role for that
parent; no member subset is formed. A separately requested admission may
reject before constructing its own identified base/signal parent. Unknown is
never zero or independence.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}\endgroup}

\providecommand{\SCIMapComparisonSpaceDefinition}{%
A numerical full-procedure difference is defined only by the complete immutable
\SCIMapComparisonSpaceRecordId{} record. The record binds baseline and perturbed product
identities; scientific quantity and unit; occurrence or MAP output-row
identities; source and target frame/WCS; additive reference, gauge, and null-
space state; baseline and perturbed support; coefficient and response basis;
one exact common comparison domain; an exact map from each result into that
domain; explicit treatment of rows present in only one result; perturbation
amplitude, sign, side, location, source state, and normalization; finite-
difference convention; state-transition record; and numerical availability
with cause. It authorizes no implicit zero fill, union-domain sentinel,
support intersection, coordinate-nearest or same-shape/row-position
association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment. Without the
complete authorized record the numerical difference is unavailable, or the
result is only a separately typed state transition/discontinuity.
\(\Delta\mathcal S_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}\) never establishes
subtractability by itself.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapCoaddResponseFamilyDefinition}{%
For one exact response family \(R\), \(T_{\rm obs}^{(R)}\) is the ordered stack
of the exact compatible member responses \(R_o^{(R)}\), and
\(R_{{\rm coadd,out}}^{(R)}=B_{\rm out}T_{\rm obs}^{(R)}\) only when every
member has that same family identity; source domain, perturbation definition,
basis, unit, normalization, reference/gauge/null state, WCS/grid and row maps
are compatible; coadd membership, centered-integer placement,
\(B_{\rm out}\), support and coefficient state are fixed for the query; and the
family is mathematically composable through that fixed linear coadd operator.
\SCIMapResponseCoaddRole{} binds the exact response-family identity it carries.
Fixed-state, PTC full-procedure finite-difference, PTC+MAP re-resolved,
coadd-re-resolved/full-procedure, and whole-chain responses are never one
unqualified family. A finite difference is not multiplied through
\(B_{\rm out}\) as though it were a linear Jacobian without an exact
composition theorem. A perturbation that may alter observation admission,
coadd membership, support, placement, coefficients, role, or plan requires a
separate coadd-full-procedure or coadd-re-resolved family and its own
\SCIMapComparisonSpaceRecordId{} record. Both that coadd-procedure response and
the whole-chain response are unavailable until separately authorized.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapNOIOwnershipStatement}{%
SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty,
conditional-scale, and standardization methods and products. Any physical-
noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, significance, probability,
false-rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a
separately approved exact method and remains unavailable by default. MAP
therefore keeps \(Q\) normalization, formal conditional precision, complete
conditional covariance, the NOI
\texttt{conditional\_detector\_sign\_randomization\_marginal\_second\_moment},
the NOI standardized signal, and any future calibrated-significance method as
distinct identities and claims.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapWCSComparisonDefinition}{%
For an immutable finite MAP grid of \(n_x\) by \(n_y\) cells, the 0.1-arcsec
representation-test population is the finite union of (a) every
scientifically addressable integer pixel center \((j+1,k+1)\) for
\(0\le j<n_x\), \(0\le k<n_y\), and (b) every outer-footprint cell vertex:
\((h+\tfrac12,\tfrac12)\), \((h+\tfrac12,n_y+\tfrac12)\) for
\(0\le h\le n_x\), together with \((\tfrac12,l+\tfrac12)\) and
\((n_x+\tfrac12,l+\tfrac12)\) for \(0\le l\le n_y\). The second set includes
all four outer corners and every required outer-boundary vertex. The complete
population is preregistered from the full-precision typed WCS, grid shape, and
row domain before the physical FITS WCS is generated. Both representations
shall bind the same WCS-generation
identity, celestial frame, axis order, signs, handedness, orientation, shape,
and centered-integer reference-pixel relation. At every population member,
each WCS is evaluated at the exactly corresponding center (zero-based memory
index \((j,k)\), one-based FITS pixel \((j+1,k+1)\)). Separation is the
great-circle angle \(\operatorname{atan2}(\lVert\boldsymbol u\times
\boldsymbol v\rVert,\boldsymbol u\!\cdot\!\boldsymbol v)\) between unit
direction vectors in that exact declared frame, evaluated with IEEE-754
binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even operations and reported in arcseconds.
The maximum over the complete finite population shall be at most 0.1 arcsec.
If either WCS yields an invalid or non-finite direction at any preregistered
member, the representation fails; the point is not dropped. A center is absent
only when its scientific row was already absent before population generation;
every listed outer-boundary vertex remains required. No smaller sampled subset
or continuum/global-sky claim is authorized.}
